criteria.evidence: destPath Lstat-walks every component refusing fs.ModeSymlink; writeDest re-checks parents one Mkdir at a time and opens the leaf with O_NOFOLLOW; TestInitRefusesToScaffoldThroughASymlink passes.

destComponents rejects absolute/unclean/'..' paths and destPath refuses a symlink at any component, so the resolved parent cannot leave destRoot (no separate EvalSymlinks comparison, but equivalent containment).
writeDest: os.OpenFile(dst, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o644) with ELOOP mapped to the symlink error.

Turn 0: 'Repository.inspectCache compares it to the configured URL on every open; a mismatch... discards the checkout and re-clones'; repository_test.go repointed/multi-URL tests; TestPublishRefusesToPushToARepointedRemote passes.
Publish calls repo.PushURL before each attempt and prints 'pushing %s to %s'; TestPublishReportsThePushDestination checks stderr names the origin.
git.Client.Isolated passes -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null and --no-verify on commit; TestIsolatedCommitIgnoresAPreCommitHook and TestPublishIgnoresAHookThatWouldWidenTheCommit pass.
Isolated client sets core.editor=true and sequence.editor=true; credential prompting deliberately left enabled and disclosed ('HTTPS pushes legitimately need it').
assertStagedScope called immediately before Commit in Publish and publishScaffold; TestPublishRefusesToCommitPathsItDidNotStage requires 'refusing to commit' naming stray.yaml.
assertCommitScope(ctx, repo.Git, 'HEAD', ...) runs inside the push loop before each attempt; non-vacuity shown by 'refusing to push HEAD: git reports planted.yaml' when isolation was disabled.
Identity is exact-string compare; TestRepositoryIdentityDistinguishesPorts (8443 vs 9443) and TestCheckoutDirSeparatesURLsDifferingOnlyByPort added; gitops passes.
Isolated set only at internal/gitops/repository.go; release/create.go and deploy/resolve.go clients leave it false; create.go diff shows no net change.
TestCreateHonoursSourceRepositoryHooks PASS: a pre-push hook in the source repo fires during release create's tag push.

destinationURL strips repo-local remote.origin.pushurl then re-resolves via get-url --push; mismatch fails closed; TestPublishStripsAPushURLInTheCheckout and TestPublishRefusesARewrittenPushDestination pass.
Rewrites error out naming the destination and 'configure gitopsRepo as the repository you want deployed to'; replay states the behaviour is enforced not reported.
'VET OK' then ok for internal/deploy, git, gitops, release, source.
go vet ./... && go test ./... all ok; 'FULL SUITE CLEAN'.

judge.reason: The replay implements all three P1 fixes plus the follow-up tightenings (port-strict identity, hook hardening scoped to the Isolated gitops client, pushurl stripped and pushInsteadOf/insteadOf failing closed) with tests, and the requested vet/test runs pass. Residual doubt is on n4, where the replay disabled editor prompting but explicitly left git credential prompting enabled, and on n1 being satisfied by component-wise symlink refusal rather than an explicit resolved-path comparison.
